summary: Brother of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle (John's great-grand-uncle).
bio:
Child of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan, born about 1909 (1910 census). His 1936 Luzerne marriage licence (No. 1732) names his parents as 'Addison F.' and 'Catherine Heffernan'. WWI/WWII service not found online (draft cards need a login).

FamilySearch gives Francis (Frank) Pringle a birth date of 19 Aug 1909 at Plymouth and a death date of 25 Nov 1990, with burial in Hanover Twp, Luzerne Co. It records his marriage on 21 Oct 1936 to Mary Clark (1913-2000) and has him in Wilkes-Barre in 1940 ([R4-S1]). A GenealogyBank obituary index entry for Frank Pringle is attached but was not read.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (1910 Plymouth census list of Catherine Heffernan Pringle's children)
